name: Union Living – CRM to Ops handoff

parameters.content:
## CRM → Ops move-in handoff
LeadSquared **Closed Won** → Ops task in the Ops Queue sheet (with Ready-by) → WhatsApp to the wing's Ops contact.
Every Monday 09:00 IST: the move-in review summary.
Rules live in one place: the Code nodes (source: handoff.js).

### Sample payload
Right now `send-test.sh` posts a LeadSquared-shaped sample lead.
To go live: in LeadSquared create ONE webhook on **Lead update** pointing here, with custom header `X-Handoff-Secret` (it should also fire on stage changes, and it is how a fixed missing field reaches Ops; two webhooks firing at once can create duplicate rows). Capture one real payload and adjust `fromLsq()` only.

### WhatsApp + email
Email (Gmail) carries the demo. WhatsApp is wired and live; Meta refuses sends until the account has billing set up, so a failed WhatsApp never stops the email.
Production: swap for the WATI node (`n8n-nodes-wati` → Send Template Message) with an approved utility template.

### Alternative entry (off)
If webhooks aren't available, poll LeadSquared `Leads.RecentlyModified` every 15 min with your access/secret keys. Map its output to the same fields before **Build Ops task**.
